metaData.originalTitle: QoderWork Skills 开发实践：从传统数科到 AI 数科的转型探索-我的 Skills 进阶之旅
metaData.title: QoderWork Skills Development Practice: Exploring the Transition from Traditional Data Science to AI Data Science - My Skills Advancement Journey
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically elaborates on the four-layer engineering architecture of QoderWork Skills (orchestration / parameters / implementation / knowledge), and shares practical methodologies for transitioning from traditional data science to AI data science through the author's self-developed User Insight and AB Testing Skill cases.
metaData.summary: The author, Zi Sui (from the Taobao & Tmall Group Live Streaming Technology Team), details the QoderWork Skills development system and engineering philosophy based on personal practice. The article first identifies the pain points of data science teams repeatedly running data and manually generating reports, introducing the value of Skills as "digital assistants." The core section proposes a four-layer separation architecture: SKILL.md (orchestration layer, solely responsible for process guidance), config.yaml (parameter template layer, avoiding hardcoding business values), scripts/ (implementation layer, solidifying complex logic like statistical tests and field detection), and references/ (knowledge layer, enabling progressive information disclosure). Subsequently, by deconstructing the design concepts of excellent community Skills (Follow Builders, Frontend Slides)—such as Frontend Slides' use of "NON-NEGOTIABLE" tags, anti-pattern lists, and one-shot data collection instructions—it demonstrates the concrete form of this architecture in practice. The author also shares two self-developed Skills: User Insight Report Generation (including RFM segmentation and the PIA insight framework) and AB Testing Analysis (including mandatory SRM checks, automatic method selection, and a conclusion determination matrix), summarizing the development methodology: Description is the soul, provide processes rather than code, templates are more controllable than free-form generation, config is a template not a form, and control the length. Finally, the author compares Idealab's RAG practices with QoderWork Skills, arguing that AI's ceiling depends on the quality of injected domain knowledge, and the core of data science transformation is freeing up human effort to focus on high-value business problems.

mainPoints.point: The essence of a Skill is a domain expert manual; its core is process orchestration rather than code injection.
mainPoints.explanation: SKILL.md is only responsible for defining trigger conditions, step orchestration, and exception handling, without embedding large chunks of implementation code. Specific logic is delegated to scripts/, improving analysis stability through structured instructions rather than pure code.

mainPoints.point: The four-layer architecture separation (orchestration / parameters / implementation / knowledge) achieves controllability and scalability.
mainPoints.explanation: SKILL.md controls the process, config.yaml defines parameter templates (using auto or empty values as placeholders), scripts/ solidifies deterministic logic, and references/ provides progressive knowledge disclosure—this design prevents Agent attention decay in long contexts and enables Skill reuse across scenarios.

mainPoints.point: 5 key techniques for developing high-quality Skills.
mainPoints.explanation: These include: using Description to clarify trigger scenarios, providing processes rather than code in SKILL.md, using structured output templates, treating config as a template rather than a form, controlling length, and utilizing progressive disclosure.

mainPoints.point: Engineering methods to counter Agent attention decay can be learned from the Follow Builders and Frontend Slides cases.
mainPoints.explanation: For example, Frontend Slides uses NON-NEGOTIABLE tags to repeatedly emphasize rules, explicitly lists anti-pattern checklists, and collects user information all at once. These are all effective techniques to combat AI's instability in long contexts.

mainPoints.point: The core of AI data science transformation is freeing up human effort, standardizing repetitive data runs and chart generation, and focusing on defining business problems and designing solutions.
mainPoints.explanation: Skills productize team methodologies, improving analysis efficiency while achieving knowledge retention and standardization. However, this requires significant time investment in testing (accounting for 70-80% of development) and attention to token consumption.

keyQuotes: A Skill is not "injecting a function into a model," but rather encapsulating a "reusable, verifiable, and bounded" business process into a stable capability unit.
AI's ceiling depends on the quality of the domain knowledge you inject.

The transition from traditional data science to AI data science is not about letting AI replace us, but about freeing our energy from repetitive "running data, generating charts, and writing reports" to focus on the more valuable tasks of "defining problems, designing solutions, and driving implementation."

relatedArticles.title: Harness Is Not the Goal, Knowledge Is the Moat — Knowledge Accumulation Practices of an AI Engineering Delivery Team
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Based on the engineering delivery practices of an AI Team, this article proposes that knowledge accumulation is more important than workflow orchestration, and systematically introduces a complete methodology encompassing a five-layer knowledge storage architecture, a three-level maturity system, and how workflows serve knowledge accumulation.

relatedArticles.title: Understanding Hermes in One Article: How the New Top-Tier Agent Self-Evolves from Experience
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article provides an in-depth analysis of the core innovation of the Hermes Agent—the Skills closed-loop system—detailing its complete implementation mechanism, from experience extraction and knowledge storage to intelligent retrieval and self-improvement, along with its engineering trade-offs and security considerations.

relatedArticles.title: In-Depth Analysis of AI-Generated UI Technology: Model Streaming Output and UI Rendering Practices
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically analyzes the core technologies of AI-Generated UI, focusing on the engineering practices of large language model streaming output and frontend UI rendering, covering streaming transmission protocols, mainstream open-source architectures, core challenges of streaming rendering, and AI editor implementations.

relatedArticles.title: Architecture Design for LLMs: What Makes a Truly AI-Friendly Architecture?
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically elaborates on the three paradigms of evolution from traditional engineering architecture to AI-Friendly architecture (deterministic → probabilistic, structured → semantic, static → dynamic). It also provides a detailed explanation of core capabilities such as Multi-Agent, Context Engineering, AI-Friendly APIs, and AI Observability, using the practical implementation of AI review and Q&A systems in Taobao's flash sale business as a case study.

relatedArticles.title: Harness Engineering: How I Spent a Week Boosting AI Coding Rate to 90% in an Enterprise App
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically introduces Harness Engineering, a new AI coding paradigm that elevates the AI code rate of an enterprise Java application from 25% to over 90% by building a four-element system of rules, skills, knowledge, and change management.

relatedArticles.title: Full-Stack RAG Technology Deep Dive
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically breaks down the core technologies of the full-stack RAG pipeline from a practical perspective, covering document loading, intelligent chunking, index construction, retrieval optimization, generation tuning, advanced Graph RAG, and the Ragas automated evaluation framework, emphasizing measurable, tunable, and trustworthy engineering practices.

relatedArticles.title: Best Practices for AI Code Generation Workflows in Taobao-Tmall Marketing Backend
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically summarizes the practice of the Taobao-Tmall marketing backend team in converging AI code generation from a local, decentralized model to a cloud-hosted, integrated workflow. The core methodology involves providing just enough precise knowledge, delegating deterministic logic to engineering, and establishing a positive feedback loop for knowledge.

relatedArticles.title: AI R&D Automation: Wiki Knowledge Base + Skill Pack
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details how to build a continuously growing team knowledge base and a supporting expert skill pack based on the LLM-Wiki model and the Obsidian platform to achieve AI-driven R&D automation.

relatedArticles.title: Practices and Reflections on a Real-Time Inference Commodity Domain Agent at the 10,000-Level
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details the architecture of a real-time inference commodity domain Agent built by the Taobao Commodity Center team, which adopts an event-driven, Function-Centric design. By standardizing encapsulation via AIFunction, establishing a three-tier knowledge base system, unifying online and offline workflows, and leveraging transactional domain events, the architecture enables intelligent understanding and real-time inference for hundreds of millions of products, significantly improving information completeness and R&D efficiency.

relatedArticles.title: Investing 10,000 RMB in AI: A Year of Tools, Practices, and Reflections
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: A systematic summary of a veteran developer's practical experience in the AI wave, covering everything from MAC toolchain optimization and Harness Engineering architectural constraints to building an Agent-driven automated learning loop.
